summary: Document the Computer Vision & Robotics simulation pipeline enhancements, including authentic problem-matched visual pipelines (solvePnP 3D pose axes, Lucas-Kanade optical flow vector fields, closed-loop PID servoing with motor PWM, differential drive kinematics arcs, pinhole model distance estimation, and ROS2 image publisher nodes), dynamic scene synchronization, and realistic visual error state rendering when user code fails or encounters syntax errors.
